recent_en: MUIPROP recently proposed to acquire 8 parcels of freehold land in Mukim Ijok for approximately RM605.00 million in cash, and declared an interim single-tier dividend of 3.5 sen per share. The company also issued its 2026 annual report and AGM notice, with the 60th AGM scheduled for 9 December 2026.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 8 parcels of freehold land in Mukim Ijok for approximately RM605.00 million in cash.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 3.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 November 2025.
